reason: The first independent materializer review correctly rejected a vacuous rule that derived each threshold from the same B03 target it evaluated. This amendment freezes the already-established development triad rule before rendering so post-render materialization cannot tune to B03 outcomes.
change_scope: materialization and DeltaE configuration derivation only; the accepted render plan, six recipes, three development batches, source stage, renderer, validator, camera, lights, and all leakage boundaries are unchanged

frozen_rule.reference_center: elementwise mean Lab of the matched B01 and B02 donor records for the same recipe, tank and stage
frozen_rule.configuration_target_gate: every one of the 16 B03 recipe-stage targets must have target_to_reference_center_delta_e76 <= threshold_delta_e76
frozen_rule.failure_behavior: fail closed on any missing or mismatched peer, non-independent donor run, peer spread above 2.0, nonfinite value, denominator mismatch, or B03 target outside the frozen threshold
frozen_rule.published_detail: publish the two peer identities, reference-center Lab, peer spread, derived threshold, B03 target distance and pass/fail for every recipe-stage key

claim_boundary: This freezes a synthetic development decision rule; it is not evidence of physical cleanliness, plant validity, or test performance.
